points.title: 早年教育
points.description: 1743年5月24日，马拉出生于瑞士纳沙泰尔的一个新教徒家庭。他的父亲是来自意大利撒丁岛的移民，母亲是日内瓦人。马拉在纳沙泰尔接受了早期教育，后来在法国波城完成中学学业。这段时期，马拉展现出对科学的浓厚兴趣，特别是对医学和物理学的热情，为他后来的科学研究和政治生涯奠定了基础。
points.descriptionEn: Born on May 24, 1743, in Neuchâtel, Switzerland, to a Protestant family of Sardinian origin. Marat received his early education in Neuchâel and completed secondary education in Pau, France. During this period, he developed a strong interest in science, particularly medicine and physics, which laid the foundation for his later scientific research and political career.

points.title: 医学研究与流亡
points.description: 1765年，马拉前往英国爱丁堡大学学习医学，在那里获得了医学学位。他在英国生活了十余年，期间主要从事医学研究、科学实验和写作工作。马拉发表了多部关于电学和光学的科学著作，并成为英国皇家学会的成员。这段经历使马拉接触到了英国的政治思想和启蒙运动，为他后来的激进政治观点的形成埋下了伏笔。
points.descriptionEn: In 1765, Marat traveled to Edinburgh, Scotland, to study medicine at the University of Edinburgh, where he earned his medical degree. He lived in Britain for over a decade, primarily engaged in medical research, scientific experiments, and writing. Marat published several scientific works on electricity and optics and became a member of the Royal Society. This period exposed him to British political thought and the Enlightenment, which influenced his later radical political views.

points.title: 重返巴黎
points.description: 1777年，马拉回到巴黎，开始行医并继续科学研究。他试图在巴黎科学院获得职位但未成功，这使他对当时的学术机构产生不满。1780年代，马拉逐渐将注意力转向政治和社会问题，开始撰写政治文章。他发表了《奴隶制论》等著作，抨击社会不平等和专制制度。这一时期，马拉开始形成自己激进的政治理念，为法国大革命爆发后的政治活动奠定了基础。
points.descriptionEn: In 1777, Marat returned to Paris, began practicing medicine, and continued his scientific research. He failed to secure a position at the Paris Academy of Sciences, which led to his dissatisfaction with academic institutions. During the 1780s, Marat gradually shifted his focus to political and social issues, beginning to write political articles. He published works like 'On Slavery,' criticizing social inequality and专制制度. During this period, Marat developed his radical political ideas, laying the foundation for his political activities after the outbreak of the French Revolution.

points.title: 革命记者
points.description: 法国大革命爆发后，马拉创办了《人民之友》报纸，成为革命中最具影响力的记者之一。他通过报纸猛烈抨击君主制和贵族特权，呼吁彻底的社会变革。马拉的言辞激烈，常常煽动民众情绪，被称为'人民的挚友'。在此期间，他支持雅各宾派，反对吉伦特派，主张建立共和国。马拉的报纸在巴黎民众中广受欢迎，但也因其激进言论和煽动性内容而备受争议。1792年8月10日事件后，马拉的影响力达到顶峰。
points.descriptionEn: After the outbreak of the French Revolution, Marat founded the newspaper 'L'Ami du Peuple' (The Friend of the People), becoming one of the most influential journalists of the revolution. Through his newspaper, he fiercely attacked the monarchy and aristocratic privileges, calling for thorough social change. Marat's language was incendiary, often inciting public sentiment, earning him the title 'Friend of the People.' During this period, he supported the Jacobins and opposed the Girondins, advocating for a republic. Marat's newspaper was widely popular among Parisian citizens but also controversial for its radical rhetoric and inflammatory content. His influence peaked after the August 10, 1792, event.

points.title: 革命领袖
points.description: 1792年9月，马拉当选国民公会代表，正式进入政治核心圈。他支持处决路易十六，推动建立革命法庭，并主张对革命敌人采取严厉措施。1793年6月，吉伦特派被推翻后，马拉成为雅各宾派政府的重要人物。然而，他的极端政策和激进立场也引起了众多政敌的敌意。1793年7月13日，保皇党人夏洛特·科黛在马拉的浴缸中刺杀了他，使其成为法国大革命中最著名的烈士之一。马拉的死亡进一步激化了革命阵营的内部斗争，加速了雅各宾派的恐怖统治。
points.descriptionEn: In September 1792, Marat was elected as a deputy to the National Convention, formally entering the political core. He supported the execution of Louis XVI, pushed for the establishment of the Revolutionary Tribunal, and advocated for harsh measures against enemies of the revolution. After the overthrow of the Girondins in June 1793, Marat became an important figure in the Jacobin government. However, his extreme policies and radical stance also earned him many political enemies. On July 13, 1793, the royalist Charlotte Corday assassinated Marat in his bathtub, making him one of the most famous martyrs of the French Revolution. Marat's death further intensified internal struggles within the revolutionary camp, accelerating the Jacobin Reign of Terror.

appraisal.zh: 马拉在史学中常被列为大革命中最具争议的人物之一：他借《人民之友》揭露权贵、为无特权者发声，其对建立共和国的投入与不屈的斗争精神受到肯定，浴缸中遇刺的形象也因大卫的名画而深入人心。然而另一种看法认为，他的言论直接助长了暴力升级，推动未经审判的处决与镇压，所谓「人民之友」实为追逐个人权力，其偏执与不容异己加剧了革命阵营的分裂与恐怖统治。他的评价分歧之大，本身即体现激进理想与极端手段之间的张力。
appraisal.en: Marat is usually counted among the most controversial figures of the Revolution: through L'Ami du Peuple he exposed the powerful and gave voice to the unprivileged, and his commitment to founding the republic and uncompromising struggle are acknowledged, while his bathtub assassination, immortalized by David's painting, remains iconic. Yet another view holds that his rhetoric directly fueled escalating violence, promoting executions without trial and repression, that his 'Friend of the People' stance masked a pursuit of personal power, and that his paranoia and intolerance deepened splits among revolutionaries and fed the Terror. The sheer divergence of assessments itself captures the tension between radical ideals and extreme means.

supporter.zh: 支持者将马拉视为法国大革命中最坚定的革命战士和人民利益的捍卫者。他们认为马拉通过《人民之友》报纸揭露了贵族和资产阶级的虚伪，为无特权阶层发声。马拉的激进立场和毫不妥协的革命精神使他成为穷人和被压迫者的象征。支持者强调马拉对建立共和国的贡献，以及他对革命敌人的毫不留情的斗争精神，认为这是实现社会正义的必要手段。
supporter.en: Supporters view Marat as one of the most steadfast revolutionaries and defenders of popular interests during the French Revolution. They argue that through his newspaper 'L'Ami du Peuple,' he exposed the hypocrisy of aristocrats and bourgeoisie, giving voice to the unprivileged classes. Marat's radical stance and uncompromising revolutionary spirit made him a symbol for the poor and oppressed. Supporters emphasize his contributions to establishing a republic and his relentless struggle against enemies of the revolution, seeing this as necessary for achieving social justice.

critic.zh: 批评者指责马拉是煽动暴力和恐怖的极端分子，认为他的言论直接导致了革命中的暴力升级。他们批评马拉利用报纸煽动民众情绪，推动未经审判的处决和暴力镇压。批评者认为马拉的'人民之友'身份是虚伪的，因为他实际上是在追求个人权力和影响力，而非真正关心普通民众。此外，马拉的偏执和不容异己的态度也被视为导致革命阵营分裂和恐怖统治的重要因素。
critic.en: Critics accuse Marat of being an extremist who incited violence and terror, arguing that his rhetoric directly contributed to the escalation of violence during the revolution. They criticize his use of the newspaper to incite public sentiment and promote executions without trial and violent repression. Critics argue that Marat's identity as the 'Friend of the People' was hypocritical, as he was actually pursuing personal power and influence rather than genuinely caring for ordinary citizens. Additionally, Marat's paranoia and intolerance of dissent are seen as significant factors contributing to the division within revolutionary ranks and the Reign of Terror.

objective.zh: 客观历史视角下，马拉被视为法国大革命中最具争议和复杂性的政治人物之一。历史学家承认他作为记者的影响力，但也指出其言论的极端性和煽动性。在流行文化中，马拉常被描绘成浴缸中的革命者形象，这一形象源于雅克-路易·大卫的名画《马拉之死》。学术界对马拉的评价呈现多元化，既有研究强调他对民主进程的贡献，也有研究分析其激进思想对革命暴力的影响。总体而言，马拉代表了法国大革命中激进民主派的理想与极端手段之间的张力。
objective.en: From an objective historical perspective, Marat is regarded as one of the most controversial and complex political figures of the French Revolution. Historians acknowledge his influence as a journalist but also point out the extremism and incitement in his rhetoric. In popular culture, Marat is often depicted as the revolutionary in his bathtub, an image derived from Jacques-Louis David's famous painting 'The Death of Marat.' Academic evaluations of Marat are diverse, with some studies emphasizing his contributions to the democratic process and others analyzing the impact of his radical ideas on revolutionary violence. Overall, Marat represents the tension between the ideals of radical democracy and extreme measures during the French Revolution.

self.zh: 人民需要的是面包，不是宪法。
self.en: The people need bread, not a constitution.
